summary.zh-CN: 让会话运行状态更清楚，并提升连续输入、网络恢复与内嵌浏览器操作的可靠性。
summary.en-US: Makes active sessions easier to understand while improving continuous input, network recovery, and embedded browser controls.

body.zh-CN: 会话工作台会按模型显示输入、输出、缓存输入、总量和缓存命中率。
body.en-US: The session workspace shows input, output, cached input, total tokens, and cache hit rate by model.

body.zh-CN: 可以从当前会话直接创建继承上下文的子会话，把并行工作拆开处理。
body.en-US: You can create a child session that inherits the current context and separate parallel work.

body.zh-CN: 命令运行时持续显示耗时，并在成功、失败、取消或刷新后保留最终时间。
body.en-US: Commands show elapsed time while running and retain their final duration after completion, cancellation, or refresh.

body.zh-CN: CLI Agent 执行期间可以继续提交输入，后续消息会按顺序进入既有队列。
body.en-US: You can submit more CLI input during an active agent run, with follow-up messages joining the existing queue in order.

title.zh-CN: 网络中断后的会话恢复

body.zh-CN: Web Chat 会恢复流式会话并继续同步服务端状态，减少重连后的旧状态。
body.en-US: Web Chat recovers streaming conversations and resumes server-state synchronization after reconnection.

title.zh-CN: 稳定的内嵌浏览器标签操作

body.zh-CN: 标签关闭按钮和紧凑标签操作不再因点击区域与覆盖层冲突而失效。
body.en-US: Tab close buttons and compact tab actions no longer fail because click targets and overlays conflict.

body.zh-CN: 缓存命中率只在模型返回缓存输入信息时显示；运行中的 CLI 输入仍按顺序处理。
body.en-US: Cache hit rates appear only when reported by the model, and CLI input submitted during a run remains ordered.
